ability.en: You start knowing that 1 of 2 players is a particular Townsfolk.
ability.fr: Lors de votre première nuit, vous apprenez un rôle de Villageois en jeu parmi 2 joueurs.

firstNightReminder.en: Show the character token of a Townsfolk in play. Point to two players, one of which is that character.

ability.en: You start knowing that 1 of 2 players is a particular Outsider. (Or that zero are in play.)
ability.fr: Lors de votre première nuit, vous apprenez un rôle de Marginal en jeu parmi 2 joueurs (ou qu’aucun Marginal n’est en jeu).

firstNightReminder.en: Show the character token of an Outsider in play. Point to two players, one of which is that character.

ability.en: You start knowing that 1 of 2 players is a particular Minion.
ability.fr: Lors de votre première nuit, vous apprenez un rôle de Sbire en jeu parmi 2 joueurs.

firstNightReminder.en: Show the character token of a Minion in play. Point to two players, one of which is that character.

ability.en: You start knowing how many pairs of evil players there are.
ability.fr: Lors de votre première nuit, vous apprenez le nombre de paires de joueurs maléfiques.

firstNightReminder.en: Show the finger signal (0, 1, 2, …) for the number of pairs of neighbouring evil players.

ability.en: Each night, you learn how many of your 2 alive neighbours are evil.
ability.fr: Chaque nuit, vous apprenez combien de vos 2 voisins en vie sont maléfiques.

firstNightReminder.en: Show the finger signal (0, 1, 2) for the number of evil alive neighbours of the Empath.

otherNightReminder.en: Show the finger signal (0, 1, 2) for the number of evil neighbours.

ability.en: Each night, choose 2 players: you learn if either is a Demon. There is a good player that registers as a Demon to you.
ability.fr: Chaque nuit, choisissez 2 joueurs et apprenez si un Démon est parmi eux. Un des joueurs bons vous apparaît comme un Démon.

firstNightReminder.en: The Fortune Teller points to two players. Give the head signal (nod yes, shake no) for whether one of those players is the Demon.

otherNightReminder.en: The Fortune Teller points to two players. Show the head signal (nod 'yes', shake 'no') for whether one of those players is the Demon.

ability.en: Each night*, you learn which character died by execution today.
ability.fr: Chaque nuit*, vous apprenez quel rôle est mort par exécution dans la journée.

otherNightReminder.en: If a player was executed today: Show that player’s character token.

ability.en: Each night*, choose a player (not yourself): they are safe from the Demon tonight.
ability.fr: Chaque nuit*, choisissez un joueur (sauf vous-même) : il est protégé du Démon cette nuit.

otherNightReminder.en: The previously protected player is no longer protected. The Monk points to a player not themself. Mark that player 'Protected'.

ability.en: If you die at night, you are woken to choose a player: you learn their character.
ability.fr: Si vous mourez la nuit, vous êtes réveillée pour choisir un joueur et apprendre son rôle.

otherNightReminder.en: If the Ravenkeeper died tonight: The Ravenkeeper points to a player. Show that player’s character token.

ability.en: The 1st time you are nominated, if the nominator is a Townsfolk, they are executed immediately.
ability.fr: La première fois qu’un joueur vous nomme, il est exécuté immédiatement s’il s’agit d’un Villageois.

ability.en: Once per game, during the day, publicly choose a player: if they are the Demon, they die.
ability.fr: Une fois par partie, dans la journée, choisissez publiquement un joueur : si ce joueur est le Démon, il meurt.

ability.en: You are safe from the Demon.
ability.fr: Vous êtes protégé du Démon.

ability.en: If only 3 players live & no execution occurs, your team wins. If you die at night, another player might die instead.
ability.fr: S’il n’y a que 3 joueurs en vie et pas d’exécution, votre équipe gagne. Si vous mourez la nuit, un autre joueur pourrait mourir à votre place.

ability.en: Each night, choose a player (not yourself): tomorrow, you may only vote if they are voting too.
ability.fr: Chaque nuit, choisissez un joueur (sauf vous-même). Le lendemain, vous pouvez voter uniquement si ce joueur vote.

firstNightReminder.en: The Butler points to a player. Mark that player as 'Master'.

otherNightReminder.en: The Butler points to a player. Mark that player as 'Master'.

ability.en: You do not know you are the Drunk. You think you are a Townsfolk character, but you are not.
ability.fr: Vous ne savez pas que vous êtes l’Ivrogne. Vous pensez que vous êtes un Villageois.

ability.en: You might register as evil & as a Minion or Demon, even if dead.
ability.fr: Vous pourriez apparaître comme maléfique et comme Sbire ou Démon, même morte.

ability.en: If you die by execution, your team loses.
ability.fr: Si vous mourez par exécution, votre équipe perd.

ability.en: Each night, choose a player: they are poisoned tonight and tomorrow day.
ability.fr: Chaque nuit, choisissez un joueur : il est empoisonné cette nuit et le jour suivant.

firstNightReminder.en: The Poisoner points to a player. That player is poisoned.

otherNightReminder.en: The previously poisoned player is no longer poisoned. The Poisoner points to a player. That player is poisoned.

ability.en: Each night, you see the Grimoire. You might register as good & as a Townsfolk or Outsider, even if dead.
ability.fr: Chaque nuit, vous voyez le Grimoire. Vous pourriez apparaître comme bonne et comme Villageois ou Marginal, même morte.

firstNightReminder.en: Show the Grimoire to the Spy for as long as they need.

otherNightReminder.en: Show the Grimoire to the Spy for as long as they need.

ability.en: If there are 5 or more players alive & the Demon dies, you become the Demon. (Travellers don’t count)
ability.fr: S’il y a au moins 5 joueurs en vie et que le Démon meurt, vous devenez le Démon. (Les Voyageurs ne comptent pas.)

otherNightReminder.en: If the Scarlet Woman became the Demon today: Show the 'You are' card, then the demon token.

ability.en: There are extra Outsiders in play. [+2 Outsiders]
ability.fr: Il y a des Marginaux supplémentaires en jeu.[+2  Marginaux]

ability.en: Each night*, choose a player: they die. If you kill yourself this way, a Minion becomes the Imp.
ability.fr: Chaque nuit* (sauf la première), choisissez un joueur : il meurt. Si vous vous tuez de cette façon, un Sbire devient le Diablotin.

otherNightReminder.en: The Imp points to a player. That player dies. If the Imp chose themselves: Replace the character of 1 alive minion with a spare Imp token. Show the 'You are' card, then the Imp token.

ability.en: Each night, choose a player (not yourself): their vote counts as 3 votes tomorrow.

firstNightReminder.en: The Bureaucrat points to a player. Put the Bureaucrat's '3 votes' reminder by the chosen player's character token.

otherNightReminder.en: The Bureaucrat points to a player. Put the Bureaucrat's '3 votes' reminder by the chosen player's character token.

ability.en: Each night, choose a player (not yourself): their vote counts negatively tomorrow.

firstNightReminder.en: The Thief points to a player. Put the Thief's 'Negative vote' reminder by the chosen player's character token.

otherNightReminder.en: The Thief points to a player. Put the Thief's 'Negative vote' reminder by the chosen player's character token.

ability.en: Each day, after the 1st vote has been tallied, you may choose a player that voted: they die.
If a player of your alignment is executed, you might be executed instead.
You must use a vote token to vote. Dead players may choose to give you theirs. If so, you learn their alignment. You are sober & healthy.
You start knowing a good player & their character. If the Demon kills them, you die too.
ability.fr: Lors de votre première nuit, vous apprenez un joueur bon et son rôle. Si le Démon tue ce joueur, vous mourez également

firstNightReminder.en: Show the marked character token. Point to the marked player.

otherNightReminder.en: If the Grandmother’s grandchild was killed by the Demon tonight: The Grandmother dies.

ability.en: Each night, choose an alive player: either you or they are drunk until dusk. You can't die.
ability.fr: Chaque nuit, choisissez un joueur en vie : lui ou vous êtes ivre jusqu’au crépuscule. Vous ne pouvez pas mourir.

firstNightReminder.en: The Sailor points to a living player. Either the Sailor, or the chosen player, is drunk.

otherNightReminder.en: The previously drunk player is no longer drunk. The Sailor points to a living player. Either the Sailor, or the chosen player, is drunk.

ability.en: Each night, choose 2 alive players (not yourself): you learn how many woke tonight due to their ability.
ability.fr: Chaque nuit, choisissez 2 joueurs en vie (sauf vous-même) : vous apprenez combien d’entre eux se sont réveillés cette nuit à cause de leur capacité.

firstNightReminder.en: The Chambermaid points to two players. Show the number signal (0, 1, 2, …) for how many of those players wake tonight for their ability.

otherNightReminder.en: The Chambermaid points to two players. Show the number signal (0, 1, 2, …) for how many of those players wake tonight for their ability.

ability.en: Each night*, choose a player (different to last night): the Demon, if chosen, learns who you are then doesn't wake tonight.
ability.fr: Chaque nuit*, choisissez un joueur (différent de la nuit précédente) : si c’est le [Démon](../demons.md), il apprend qui vous êtes puis ne se réveille pas cette nuit.

otherNightReminder.en: The Exorcist points to a player, different from the previous night. If that player is the Demon: Wake the Demon. Show the Exorcist token. Point to the Exorcist. The Demon does not act tonight.

ability.en: Each night*, choose 2 players: they can't die tonight, but 1 is drunk until dusk.
ability.fr: Chaque nuit*, choisissez 2 joueurs : ils ne peuvent pas mourir cette nuit, mais l’un d’eux est ivre jusqu’au crépuscule.

otherNightReminder.en: The previously protected and drunk players lose those markers. The Innkeeper points to two players. Those players are protected. One is drunk.

ability.en: Each night*, choose a player & guess their character: if you guess wrong, you die.
ability.fr: Chaque nuit*, choisissez un joueur et devinez son rôle. Si vous vous trompez, vous mourez.

otherNightReminder.en: The Gambler points to a player, and a character on their sheet. If incorrect, the Gambler dies.

ability.en: Each day, you may make a public statement. Tonight, if it was true, a player dies.
ability.fr: Chaque jour, vous pouvez faire une annonce publiquement. Cette nuit, si votre annonce était vraie, un joueur meurt.

otherNightReminder.en: If the Gossip’s public statement was true: Choose a player not protected from dying tonight. That player dies.

ability.en: Once per game, at night, choose a character: they are drunk for 3 nights & 3 days.
ability.fr: Une fois par partie, la nuit, choisissez un rôle : il est ivre pendant 3 nuits et 3 jours.

firstNightReminder.en: The Courtier either shows a 'no' head signal, or points to a character on the sheet. If the Courtier used their ability: If that character is in play, that player is drunk.

otherNightReminder.en: Reduce the remaining number of days the marked player is poisoned. If the Courtier has not yet used their ability: The Courtier either shows a 'no' head signal, or points to a character on the sheet. If the Courtier used their ability: If that character is in play, that player is drunk.

ability.en: Once per game, at night*, choose a dead player: if they are a Townsfolk, they are resurrected.
ability.fr: Une fois par partie, la nuit*, choisissez un joueur mort : si c’est un Villageois, il est ressuscité.

otherNightReminder.en: If the Professor has not used their ability: The Professor either shakes their head no, or points to a player. If that player is a Townsfolk, they are now alive.

ability.en: When a Minion dies by execution, all other players (except Travellers) are drunk until dusk tomorrow.
ability.fr: Lorsqu’un Sbire meurt par exécution, tous les autres joueurs (sauf les Voyageurs) sont ivres jusqu’au crépuscule du lendemain.

ability.en: If both your alive neighbours are good, they can't die.
ability.fr: Si vos deux voisins vivants sont bons, ils ne peuvent pas mourir.

ability.en: Executed good players might not die.
ability.fr: Les bons joueurs exécutés pourraient ne pas mourir.

ability.en: The first time you die, you don't.
ability.fr: La première fois que vous mourez, vous ne mourez pas.

ability.en: You might die at any time.
ability.fr: Vous pourriez mourir à tout moment.

otherNightReminder.en: The Tinker might die.

ability.en: When you learn that you died, publicly choose 1 alive player. Tonight, if it was a good player, they die.
ability.fr: Lorsque vous apprenez que vous êtes morte, choisissez publiquement un joueur vivant. Cette nuit, si ce joueur était bon, il meurt.

otherNightReminder.en: If the Moonchild used their ability to target a player today: If that player is good, they die.

ability.en: Each night, the 1st player to choose you with their ability is drunk until dusk. You become their alignment.
ability.fr: Chaque nuit, le premier joueur qui vous choisit avec sa capacité est ivre jusqu'au crépuscule. Vous devenez son alignement.

ability.en: You think you are a Demon, but you are not. The Demon knows who you are & who you choose at night.
ability.fr: Vous pensez que vous êtes un Démon. Le Démon sait qui vous êtes et qui vous choisissez la nuit.

firstNightReminder.en: If 7 or more players: Show the Lunatic a number of arbitrary 'Minions', players equal to the number of Minions in play. Show 3 character tokens of arbitrary good characters. If the token received by the Lunatic is a Demon that would wake tonight: Allow the Lunatic to do the Demon actions. Place their 'attack' markers. Wake the Demon. Show the Demon’s real character token. Show them the Lunatic player. If the Lunatic attacked players: Show the real demon each marked player. Remove any Lunatic 'attack' markers.

otherNightReminder.en: Allow the Lunatic to do the actions of the Demon. Place their 'attack' markers. If the Lunatic selected players: Wake the Demon. Show the 'attack' marker, then point to each marked player. Remove any Lunatic 'attack' markers.

ability.en: You start knowing which Outsiders are in play. If 1 died today, choose a player tonight: they die. [−1 or +1 Outsider]
ability.fr: Lors de votre première nuit, vous apprenez quels Marginaux sont en jeu. Si un Marginal meurt dans la journée, choisissez un joueur cette nuit : il meurt. [-1 ou +1 Marginal]

firstNightReminder.en: Show each of the Outsider tokens in play.

otherNightReminder.en: If an Outsider died today: The Godfather points to a player. That player dies.

ability.en: Each night, choose a living player (different to last night): if executed tomorrow, they don't die.
ability.fr: Chaque nuit, choisissez un joueur en vie (différent de la nuit précédente) : s’il est exécuté le lendemain, il ne meurt pas.

firstNightReminder.en: The Devil’s Advocate points to a living player. That player survives execution tomorrow.

otherNightReminder.en: The Devil’s Advocate points to a living player, different from the previous night. That player survives execution tomorrow.

ability.en: Once per game, at night*, choose a player: they die, even if for some reason they could not.
ability.fr: Une fois par partie, la nuit*, choisissez un joueur : il meurt, même s’il ne peut normalement pas mourir.

otherNightReminder.en: If the Assassin has not yet used their ability: The Assassin either shows the 'no' head signal, or points to a player. That player dies.

ability.en: If the Demon dies by execution (ending the game), play for 1 more day. If a player is then executed, their team loses.
ability.fr: Si le Démon meurt par exécution (mettant fin à la partie), vous jouez 1 jour de plus. Si un joueur est exécuté ce jour-là, son équipe perd.

ability.en: Each night*, if no-one died today, choose a player: they die. The 1st time you die, you live but register as dead.
ability.fr: Chaque nuit*, si personne n’est mort dans la journée, choisissez un joueur : il meurt. La première fois que vous mourez, vous restez en vie, mais apparaissez comme mort.

otherNightReminder.en: If no-one died during the day: The Zombuul points to a player. That player dies.

ability.en: Each night, choose a player: they are poisoned. The previously poisoned player dies then becomes healthy.
ability.fr: Chaque nuit, choisissez un joueur : il est empoisonné. Le joueur précédemment empoisonné meurt, puis devient sain.

firstNightReminder.en: The Pukka points to a player. That player is poisoned.

otherNightReminder.en: The Pukka points to a player. That player is poisoned. The previously poisoned player dies.

ability.en: Each night*, choose 2 players: they die. A dead player you chose last night might be regurgitated.
ability.fr: Chaque nuit*, choisissez 2 joueurs : ils meurent. Un joueur mort que vous avez choisi lors de la nuit précédente pourrait être recraché.

otherNightReminder.en: One player that the Shabaloth chose the previous night might be resurrected. The Shabaloth points to two players. Those players die.

ability.en: Each night*, you may choose a player: they die. If your last choice was no-one, choose 3 players tonight.
ability.fr: Chaque nuit*, vous pouvez choisir un joueur : il meurt. Si votre dernier choix était « personne », choisissez 3 joueurs cette nuit

otherNightReminder.en: If the Po chose no-one the previous night: The Po points to three players. Otherwise: The Po either shows the 'no' head signal , or points to a player. Chosen players die

ability.en: On your 1st night, you gain a Townsfolk ability (if good), or a Minion ability (if evil).

firstNightReminder.en: Show the Apprentice the 'You are' card, then a Townsfolk or Minion token. In the Grimoire, replace the Apprentice token with that character token, and put the Apprentice's 'Is the Apprentice' reminder by that character token.

ability.en: Each day, you may choose up to 3 sets of 2 players to swap seats. Players may not leave their seats to talk in private.
Once per game, if another player nominated, you may choose to force the current execution to pass or fail.
Only the Storyteller can nominate. At least 1 opposite player must be nominated each day.
Only you and the dead can vote. They don't need a vote token to do so. A 50% majority is not required.
You start knowing how many steps from the Demon to its nearest Minion.
ability.fr: Lors de votre première nuit, vous apprenez à combien de places du Démon est assis son Sbire le plus proche.

firstNightReminder.en: Show the hand signal for the number (1, 2, 3, etc.) of places from Demon to closest Minion.

ability.en: Each night, choose a player (not yourself or Travellers): you learn 1 good and 1 evil character, 1 of which is correct.
ability.fr: Chaque nuit, choisissez un joueur (sauf vous-même ni les voyageurs) : vous apprenez 1 rôle bon et 1 rôle maléfique, dont 1 est correct.

firstNightReminder.en: The Dreamer points to a player. Show 1 good and 1 evil character token; one of these is correct.

otherNightReminder.en: The Dreamer points to a player. Show 1 good and 1 evil character token; one of these is correct.

ability.en: Each night, choose an alive player: a chosen Demon swaps characters & alignments with you & is then poisoned.
ability.fr: Chaque nuit, choisissez un joueur en vie : si c’est un Démon, il échange de rôle et d’alignement avec vous, puis est empoisonné.

firstNightReminder.en: The Snake Charmer points to a player. If that player is the Demon: swap the Demon and Snake Charmer character and alignments. Wake each player to inform them of their new role and alignment. The new Snake Charmer is poisoned.

otherNightReminder.en: The Snake Charmer points to a player. If that player is the Demon: swap the Demon and Snake Charmer character and alignments. Wake each player to inform them of their new role and alignment. The new Snake Charmer is poisoned.

ability.en: Each night, you learn how many players’ abilities worked abnormally (since dawn) due to another character's ability.
ability.fr: Chaque nuit, vous apprenez combien de joueurs ont vu leur capacité dysfonctionner (depuis l’aube) à cause de la capacité d’un autre rôle.

firstNightReminder.en: Show the hand signal for the number (0, 1, 2, etc.) of players whose ability malfunctioned due to other abilities.

otherNightReminder.en: Show the hand signal for the number (0, 1, 2, etc.) of players whose ability malfunctioned due to other abilities.

ability.en: Each night*, you learn if a Demon voted today.
ability.fr: Chaque nuit*, vous apprenez si un Démon a voté dans la journée.

otherNightReminder.en: Nod 'yes' or shake head 'no' for whether the Demon voted today. Place the 'Demon not voted' marker (remove 'Demon voted', if any).

ability.en: Each night*, you learn if a Minion nominated today.
ability.fr: Chaque nuit*, vous apprenez si un Sbire a nommé quelqu’un dans la journée.

otherNightReminder.en: Nod 'yes' or shake head 'no' for whether a Minion nominated today. Place the 'Minion not nominated' marker (remove 'Minion nominated', if any).

ability.en: Each night*, you learn how many dead players are evil.
ability.fr: Chaque nuit*, vous apprenez combien de joueurs morts sont maléfiques.

otherNightReminder.en: Show the hand signal for the number (0, 1, 2, etc.) of dead evil players.

ability.en: Each day, you may visit the Storyteller to learn 2 things in private: 1 is true & 1 is false.
ability.fr: Chaque jour, vous pouvez rendre visite au Conteur pour apprendre 2 informations en privé : l’une est vraie et l’autre est fausse.

ability.en: Once per game, at night, choose 2 players (not yourself): you learn if they are the same alignment.
ability.fr: Une fois par partie, la nuit, choisissez 2 joueurs (sauf vous-même) : vous apprenez s’ils sont du même alignement.

firstNightReminder.en: The Seamstress either shows a 'no' head signal, or points to two other players. If the Seamstress chose players , nod 'yes' or shake 'no' for whether they are of same alignment.

otherNightReminder.en: If the Seamstress has not yet used their ability: the Seamstress either shows a 'no' head signal, or points to two other players. If the Seamstress chose players , nod 'yes' or shake 'no' for whether they are of same alignment.

ability.en: Once per game, at night, choose a good character: gain that ability. If this character is in play, they are drunk.
ability.fr: Une fois par partie, la nuit, choisissez un rôle bon : gagnez cette capacité. Si ce rôle est en jeu, il est ivre.

firstNightReminder.en: The Philosopher either shows a 'no' head signal, or points to a good character on their sheet. If they chose a character: Swap the out-of-play character token with the Philosopher token and add the 'Is the Philosopher' reminder. If the character is in play, place the drunk marker by that player.

otherNightReminder.en: If the Philosopher has not used their ability: the Philosopher either shows a 'no' head signal, or points to a good character on their sheet. If they chose a character: Swap the out-of-play character token with the Philosopher token and add the 'Is the Philosopher' reminder. If the character is in play, place the drunk marker by that player.

ability.en: Once per game, during the day, privately ask the Storyteller any yes/no question.
ability.fr: Une fois par partie, dans la journée, posez en privé une question fermée (oui/non) au Conteur.

ability.en: On your 1st day, publicly guess up to 5 players' characters. That night, you learn how many you got correct.
ability.fr: Lors de votre premier jour, devinez publiquement jusqu’à 5 rôles de joueurs. Cette nuit, vous apprenez combien étaient corrects.

otherNightReminder.en: If today was the Juggler’s first day: Show the hand signal for the number (0, 1, 2, etc.) of 'Correct' markers. Remove markers.

ability.en: If the Demon kills you, you learn that it is 1 of 2 players.
ability.fr: Si le Démon vous tue, vous apprenez qui est le Démon parmi 2 joueurs.

otherNightReminder.en: If the Sage was killed by a Demon: Point to two players, one of which is that Demon.

ability.en: If you are “mad” about being an Outsider, you might be executed.
ability.fr: Si vous vous montrez « fou » d’être un Marginal, vous pourriez être exécuté.

ability.en: When you die, 1 player is drunk from now on.
ability.fr: Lorsque vous mourez, 1 joueur est désormais ivre.

otherNightReminder.en: Choose a player that is drunk.

ability.en: If you died today or tonight, the Demon may choose 2 players (not another Demon) to swap characters.
ability.fr: Si vous êtes mort dans la journée ou cette nuit, le Démon peut choisir 2 joueurs (mais pas un autre Démon) qui échangent alors leur rôle.

otherNightReminder.en: If the Barber died today: Wake the Demon. Show the 'This character selected you' card, then Barber token. The Demon either shows a 'no' head signal, or points to 2 players. If they chose players: Swap the character tokens. Wake each player. Show 'You are', then their new character token.

ability.en: When you learn that you died, publicly choose 1 alive player: if they are evil, your team loses.
ability.fr: Lorsque vous apprenez que vous êtes mort, choisissez publiquement 1 joueur en vie. S’il est maléfique, votre équipe perd.

ability.en: You & an opposing player know each other. If the good player is executed, evil wins. Good can't win if you both live.
ability.fr: Vous et un joueur d’alignement opposé vous connaissez mutuellement. Si le joueur bon est exécuté, le Mal gagne. Le Bien ne peut pas gagner si vous restez tous les deux en vie.

firstNightReminder.en: Wake the Evil Twin and their twin. Confirm that they have acknowledged each other. Point to the Evil Twin. Show their Evil Twin token to the twin player. Point to the twin. Show their character token to the Evil Twin player.

ability.en: Each night, choose a player: if they nominate tomorrow, they die. If just 3 players live, you lose this ability.
ability.fr: Chaque nuit, choisissez un joueur : s’il nomme quelqu’un le lendemain, il meurt. S’il ne reste que 3 joueurs en vie, vous perdez cette capacité.

firstNightReminder.en: The Witch points to a player. If that player nominates tomorrow they die immediately.

otherNightReminder.en: If there are 4 or more players alive: The Witch points to a player. If that player nominates tomorrow they die immediately.

ability.en: Each night, choose a player & a good character: they are “mad” they are this character tomorrow, or might be executed.
ability.fr: Chaque nuit, choisissez un joueur et un rôle bon : le lendemain, il doit être « fou » d’être ce rôle. Sinon, il pourrait être exécuté.

firstNightReminder.en: The Cerenovus points to a player, then to a character on their sheet. Wake that player. Show the 'This character selected you' card, then the Cerenovus token. Show the selected character token. If the player is not mad about being that character tomorrow, they can be executed.

otherNightReminder.en: The Cerenovus points to a player, then to a character on their sheet. Wake that player. Show the 'This character selected you' card, then the Cerenovus token. Show the selected character token. If the player is not mad about being that character tomorrow, they can be executed.

ability.en: Each night*, choose a player & a character they become (if not-in-play). If a Demon is made, deaths tonight are arbitrary.
ability.fr: Chaque nuit*, choisissez un joueur et le rôle qu’il devient (s’il n’est pas en jeu). Si un Démon est créé, les morts de cette nuit sont arbitraires.

otherNightReminder.en: The Pit-Hag points to a player and a character on the sheet. If this character is not in play, wake that player and show them the 'You are' card and the relevant character token. If the character is in play, nothing happens.

ability.en: Each night*, choose a player: they die. The 1st Outsider this kills becomes an evil Fang Gu & you die instead. [+1 Outsider]
ability.fr: Chaque nuit*, choisissez un joueur : il meurt. Le premier Marginal tué ainsi devient un Fang Gu maléfique et vous mourez à sa place. [+1 Marginal]

otherNightReminder.en: The Fang Gu points to a player. That player dies. Or, if that player was an Outsider and there are no other Fang Gu in play: The Fang Gu dies instead of the chosen player. The chosen player is now an evil Fang Gu. Wake the new Fang Gu. Show the 'You are' card, then the Fang Gu token. Show the 'You are' card, then the thumb-down 'evil' hand sign.

ability.en: Each night*, choose a player: they die. Minions you kill keep their ability & poison 1 Townsfolk neighbour. [−1 Outsider]
ability.fr: Chaque nuit*, choisissez un joueur : il meurt. Les Sbires que vous tuez gardent leur capacité et empoisonnent 1 Villageois voisin. [-1 Marginal]

otherNightReminder.en: The Vigormortis points to a player. That player dies. If a Minion, they keep their ability and one of their Townsfolk neighbours is poisoned.

ability.en: Each night*, choose a player: they die. Your 2 Townsfolk neighbours are poisoned.
ability.fr: Chaque nuit*, choisissez un joueur : il meurt. Vos 2 Villageois voisins sont empoisonnés.

otherNightReminder.en: The No Dashii points to a player. That player dies.

ability.en: Each night*, choose a player: they die. Townsfolk abilities yield false info. Each day, if no-one is executed, evil wins.
ability.fr: Chaque nuit*, choisissez un joueur : il meurt. Les capacités des Villageois donnent de fausses informations. Chaque jour, si personne n’est exécuté, les Maléfiques gagnent.

otherNightReminder.en: The Vortox points to a player. That player dies.

ability.en: Each night, until dusk, 1) a player becomes sober, healthy and gets true info, or 2) their ability works twice. They learn which.

firstNightReminder.en: Choose a player, wake them and tell them which Barista power is affecting them. Treat them accordingly (sober/healthy/true info or activate their ability twice).

otherNightReminder.en: Choose a player, wake them and tell them which Barista power is affecting them. Treat them accordingly (sober/healthy/true info or activate their ability twice).

ability.en: Each night*, choose a living player: if they agree, you learn their character, but you both might die.

otherNightReminder.en: The Harlot points at any player. Then, put the Harlot to sleep. Wake the chosen player, show them the 'This character selected you' token, then the Harlot token. That player either nods their head yes or shakes their head no. If they nodded their head yes, wake the Harlot and show them the chosen player's character token. Then, you may decide that both players die.

ability.en: Each day, after the 1st execution, you may nominate again.
Once per game, at night, choose a dead player: they regain their ability until dusk.

otherNightReminder.en: The Bone Collector either shakes their head no or points at any dead player. If they pointed at any dead player, put the Bone Collector's 'Has Ability' reminder by the chosen player's character token. (They may need to be woken tonight to use it.)

ability.en: If you were funny today, you cannot die by exile.
You start knowing 3 players, 1 and only 1 of which is evil.

firstNightReminder.en: Point to 3 players including one evil player, in no particular order.

ability.en: You start knowing 1 evil player. If the player you know dies, you learn another evil player tonight. [1 Townsfolk is evil]

firstNightReminder.en: Point to 1 evil player. Wake the townsfolk who is evil and show them the 'You are' card and the thumbs down evil sign.

otherNightReminder.en: If the known evil player has died, point to another evil player.

ability.en: You start knowing 1 in-play Townsfolk. If you were mad that you were this character, you gain their ability when they die.

firstNightReminder.en: Show the Pixie 1 in-play Townsfolk character token.

ability.en: Each night, you learn which alignment the Storyteller believes is winning: good, evil, or neither.

firstNightReminder.en: Show the General thumbs up for good winning, thumbs down for evil winning or thumb to the side for neither.

otherNightReminder.en: Show the General thumbs up for good winning, thumbs down for evil winning or thumb to the side for neither.

ability.en: Each night, choose a player: a Minion, if chosen, learns this. All chosen Minions have no ability.

firstNightReminder.en: The Preacher chooses a player. If a Minion is chosen, wake the Minion and show the 'This character selected you' card and then the Preacher token.

otherNightReminder.en: The Preacher chooses a player. If a Minion is chosen, wake the Minion and show the 'This character selected you' card and then the Preacher token.

ability.en: Each night, if the dead outnumber the living, you learn 1 alive character. The Demon knows who you are.

firstNightReminder.en: Wake the Demon, show them the 'This character selected you' card, show the King token and point to the King player.

otherNightReminder.en: If there are more dead than living, show the King a character token of a living player.

ability.en: Each night, you learn 1 player of each character type, until there are no more types to learn. [+1 Outsider]

firstNightReminder.en: Choose a character type. Point to a player whose character is of that type. Place the Balloonist's Seen reminder next to that character.

otherNightReminder.en: Choose a character type that does not yet have a Seen reminder next to a character of that type. Point to a player whose character is of that type, if there are any. Place the Balloonist's Seen reminder next to that character.

ability.en: Each night, you become the alignment of an alive neighbour. If all good players choose to join your cult, your team wins.

firstNightReminder.en: If the cult leader changed alignment, show them the thumbs up good signal of the thumbs down evil signal accordingly.

otherNightReminder.en: If the cult leader changed alignment, show them the thumbs up good signal of the thumbs down evil signal accordingly.

ability.en: Each night*, choose a living player: if good, they die, but they are the only player that can die tonight.

otherNightReminder.en: The Lycanthrope points to a living player: if good, they die and no one else can die tonight.

ability.en: You do not know what your ability is. Each day, privately guess what it is: you learn how accurate you are.

firstNightReminder.en: Decide the Amnesiac's entire ability. If the Amnesiac's ability causes them to wake tonight: Wake the Amnesiac and run their ability.

otherNightReminder.en: If the Amnesiac's ability causes them to wake tonight: Wake the Amnesiac and run their ability.

ability.en: Once per game, at night, choose a player: they learn who you are.

firstNightReminder.en: The Nightwatchman may point to a player. Wake that player, show the 'This character selected you' card and the Nightwatchman token, then point to the Nightwatchman player.

otherNightReminder.en: The Nightwatchman may point to a player. Wake that player, show the 'This character selected you' card and the Nightwatchman token, then point to the Nightwatchman player.

ability.en: Once per game, at night, choose which Minions or which Demon is in play.

firstNightReminder.en: The Engineer shows a 'no' head signal, or points to a Demon or points to the relevant number of Minions. If the Engineer chose characters, replace the Demon or Minions with the choices, then wake the relevant players and show them the You are card and the relevant character tokens.

otherNightReminder.en: The Engineer shows a 'no' head signal, or points to a Demon or points to the relevant number of Minions. If the Engineer chose characters, replace the Demon or Minions with the choices, then wake the relevant players and show them the 'You are' card and the relevant character tokens.

ability.en: Once per game, during the day, visit the Storyteller for some advice to help you win.
Once per game, at night, choose a living player: the Damsel, if chosen, becomes a not-in-play Townsfolk. [+the Damsel]

firstNightReminder.en: The Huntsman shakes their head 'no' or points to a player. If they point to the Damsel, wake that player, show the 'You are' card and a not-in-play character token.

otherNightReminder.en: The Huntsman shakes their head 'no' or points to a player. If they point to the Damsel, wake that player, show the 'You are' card and a not-in-play character token.

ability.en: You have a not-in-play Minion ability.

firstNightReminder.en: Show the Alchemist a not-in-play Minion token

ability.en: If you die at night, an alive good player becomes a Farmer.

otherNightReminder.en: If a Farmer died tonight, choose another good player and make them the Farmer. Wake this player, show them the 'You are' card and the Farmer character token.

ability.en: The Demon thinks you are a Minion. Minions think you are a Demon.
If the Demon kills the King, you learn which player is the Demon. [+ the King]

otherNightReminder.en: If the King was killed by the Demon, wake the Choirboy and point to the Demon player.

ability.en: Minions & Demons do not know each other. If you die, they learn who each other are that night.

firstNightReminder.en: Do not inform the Demon/Minions who each other are

otherNightReminder.en: If the Poppy Grower has died, show the Minions/Demon who each other are.

ability.en: The Storyteller can break the game rules & if executed, good wins, even if you are dead. [No evil characters]
You have the ability of the recently killed executee. If they are evil, you are poisoned until a good player dies by execution.
Minions start knowing 3 not-in-play characters.

firstNightReminder.en: After Minion info wake each Minion and show them three not-in-play character tokens. These may be the same or different to each other and the ones shown to the Demon.

ability.en: Each night*, if either good living neighbour is drunk or poisoned, you die.

otherNightReminder.en: If a good living neighbour is drunk or poisoned, the Acrobat player dies.

ability.en: 1 player is drunk, even if you die. If you guess (once) who it is, learn the Demon player, but guess wrong & get false info.
Whoever wins, loses & whoever loses, wins, even if you are dead.
All Minions know you are in play. If a Minion publicly guesses you (once), your team loses.

firstNightReminder.en: Wake all the Minions, show them the 'This character selected you' card and the Damsel token.

otherNightReminder.en: If selected by the Huntsman, wake the Damsel, show 'You are' card and a not-in-play Townsfolk token.

ability.en: You may only nominate once per game. When you do, if the nominee is not the Demon, they die.
If you were the player most responsible for your team losing, you change alignment & win, even if dead.
On your 1st night, look at the Grimoire and choose a player: they are poisoned. 1 good player knows a Widow is in play.

firstNightReminder.en: Show the Grimoire to the Widow for as long as they need. The Widow points to a player. That player is poisoned. Wake a good player. Show the 'These characters are in play' card, then the Widow character token.

ability.en: Each night, choose a player. If you nominate & execute them, their team loses. All players know if you choose a new player.

firstNightReminder.en: The Fearmonger points to a player. Place the Fear token next to that player and announce that a new player has been selected with the Fearmonger ability.

otherNightReminder.en: The Fearmonger points to a player. If different from the previous night, place the Fear token next to that player and announce that a new player has been selected with the Fearmonger ability.

ability.en: Each day, before nominations, you may publicly choose a player: they die. If executed, you only die if you lose roshambo.
If you publicly claim to be the Goblin when nominated & are executed that day, your team wins.
You start knowing a secret word. The 1st good player to say this word becomes evil that night.

firstNightReminder.en: Show the Mephit their secret word.

otherNightReminder.en: Wake the 1st good player that said the Mephit's secret word and show them the 'You are' card and the thumbs down evil signal.

ability.en: You start knowing a secret word. The 1st good player to say this word becomes evil that night.

firstNightReminder.en: Show the Mezepheles their secret word.

otherNightReminder.en: Wake the 1st good player that said the Mezepheles' secret word and show them the 'You are' card and the thumbs down evil signal.

ability.en: You think you are a good character but you are not. The Demon knows who you are. [You neighbour the Demon]

firstNightReminder.en: Select one of the good players next to the Demon and place the Is the Marionette reminder token. Wake the Demon and show them the Marionette.

ability.en: If you are executed, all but 3 players die. 1 minute later, the player with the most players pointing at them dies.
Each night, Minions choose who babysits Lil' Monsta's token & "is the Demon". A player dies each night*. [+1 Minion]

firstNightReminder.en: Wake all Minions together, allow them to vote by pointing at who they want to babysit Lil' Monsta.

otherNightReminder.en: Wake all Minions together, allow them to vote by pointing at who they want to babysit Lil' Monsta. Choose a player, that player dies.

ability.en: Each night*, choose a player: they die. You start by choosing an alive player: they are poisoned - you die if & only if they die.

firstNightReminder.en: The Lleech points to a player. Place the Poisoned reminder token.

otherNightReminder.en: The Lleech points to a player. That player dies.

ability.en: Each night*, choose 3 players (all players learn who): each silently chooses to live or die, but if all live, all die.

otherNightReminder.en: The Al-Hadikhia chooses 3 players. Announce the first player, wake them to nod yes to live or shake head no to die, kill or resurrect accordingly, then put to sleep and announce the next player. If all 3 are alive after this, all 3 die.

ability.en: Each night*, a player might die. Executions fail if only evil voted. You register as a Minion too. [Most players are Legion]

otherNightReminder.en: Choose a player, that player dies.

ability.en: If more than 1 good player is executed, you win. All players know you are in play. After day 5, evil wins.

firstNightReminder.en: Place the Leviathan 'Day 1' marker. Announce 'The Leviathan is in play; this is Day 1.'

otherNightReminder.en: Change the Leviathan Day reminder for the next day.

ability.en: Nominees die, but may nominate again immediately (on day 3, they must). After day 3, evil wins. [All Minions are Riot]
Once per day, you may choose to kill an alive neighbour, if your other alive neighbour agrees.
If 4 or more players live, each living player may publicly choose (once per game) that a player of their own alignment dies.
ability.fr: S'il reste 4 joueurs ou plus, chaque joueur vivant peut, une fois par partie, choisir publiquement qu'un joueur de son propre alignement meure.

ability.en: Something bad might happen to whoever is most responsible for the death of a new player.
ability.fr: Quelque chose de fâcheux pourrait arriver à celui qui est le plus responsable de la mort d'un nouveau joueur.

ability.en: For the first 2 minutes of each day, veteran players may not talk.
ability.fr: Pendant les 2 premières minutes de chaque jour, les joueurs expérimentés n'ont pas le droit de parler.

ability.en: Something bad might happen to whoever talks when the Storyteller has asked for silence.
ability.fr: Quelque chose de fâcheux pourrait arriver à quiconque parle alors que le Conteur a demandé le silence.

ability.en: 2 neighboring players are known to be the same alignment. Once per game, one of them registers falsely.
ability.fr: 2 joueurs voisins sont connus pour être du même alignement. Une fois par partie, l'un d'eux apparaît faussement.

ability.en: Once per game, the Demon secretly chooses an opposing player: all players choose which of these 2 players win.
ability.fr: Une fois par partie, le Démon choisit secrètement un joueur adverse : tous les joueurs votent pour lequel de ces 2 joueurs l'emporte.

ability.en: The Demon may choose not to attack & must do this at least once per game. Evil players get normal starting info.
ability.fr: Le Démon peut choisir de ne pas attaquer, et doit le faire au moins une fois par partie. Les joueurs maléfiques reçoivent des infos de départ normales.

otherNightReminder.en: If it is a night when a Demon attack could end the game, and the Demon is marked “Final night: No Attack,” then the Demon does not act tonight. (Do not wake them.)

ability.en: Once per game, 1 good player might get false information.
ability.fr: Une fois par partie, un joueur bon peut recevoir une fausse information.

ability.en: Each day, 3 players may choose to visit you. At night*, each visitor learns how many visitors are evil, but 1 gets false info.
ability.fr: Chaque jour, 3 joueurs peuvent choisir de vous rendre visite. La nuit* (sauf la 1re), chaque visiteur apprend combien de visiteurs sont maléfiques, mais l'un reçoit une fausse info.

otherNightReminder.en: Wake each player marked “Visitor” or “False Info” one at a time. Show them the Duchess token, then fingers (1, 2, 3) equaling the number of evil players marked “Visitor” or, if you are waking the player marked “False Info,” show them any number of fingers except the number of evil players marked “Visitor.”

ability.en: There might be 1 extra or 1 fewer Outsider in play.
ability.fr: Il peut y avoir 1 Marginal de plus ou de moins en jeu.

ability.en: There can't be more than 1 extra evil player.
ability.fr: Il ne peut pas y avoir plus d'1 joueur maléfique supplémentaire.

ability.en: Use the Djinn's special rule. All players know what it is.
ability.fr: Utilisez la règle spéciale du Djinn. Tous les joueurs la connaissent.

ability.en: Name a good character. If in play, they can only die by execution, but evil players learn which player it is.
ability.fr: Nommez un personnage bon. S'il est en jeu, il ne peut mourir que par exécution, mais les joueurs maléfiques apprennent de qui il s'agit.

firstNightReminder.en: Mark a good player as "Safe". Wake each evil player and show them the marked player.

chambermaid.reason: The Chambermaid learns if the Mathematician wakes tonight or not, even though the Chambermaid wakes first.

butler.reason: If the Cannibal gains the Butler ability, the Cannibal learns this.

lunatic.reason: The Mathematician learns if the Lunatic attacks a different player(s) than the real Demon attacked.

pithag.reason: A Pit-Hag can not create a Heretic.
If a Pit-Hag creates a Damsel, the Storyteller chooses which player it is.
A Pit-hag can not create an evil Politician.

cerenovus.reason: The Cerenovus may choose to make a player mad that they are the Goblin.

leviathan.reason: If Leviathan nominates and executes the Soldier, the Soldier does not die.
If Leviathan nominates and executes the player the Monk chose, that player does not die.
If Leviathan nominates and executes a player the Innkeeper chose, that player does not die.
If Leviathan is in play & the Ravenkeeper dies by execution, they wake that night to use their ability.
If Leviathan is in play & the Sage dies by execution, they wake that night to use their ability.
If Leviathan is in play & a Farmer dies by execution, a good player becomes a Farmer that night.
If Leviathan is in play & no execution occurs on day 5, good wins.

alhadikhia.reason: If there are two living Al-Hadikhias, the Scarlet Woman Al-Hadikhia becomes the Scarlet Woman again.
Only 1 jinxed character can be in play. Evil players start knowing which player and character it is.

lilmonsta.reason: If the Poppy Grower is in play, Minions don't wake together. They are woken one by one, until one of them chooses to take the Lil' Monsta token.
Only 1 jinxed character can be in play.
If there are 5 or more players alive and the player holding the Lil' Monsta token dies, the Scarlet Woman is given the Lil' Monsta token tonight.

lycanthrope.reason: If the Lycanthrope is alive and the Gambler kills themself at night, no other players can die tonight.

legion.reason: Legion and the Engineer can not both be in play at the start of the game. If the Engineer creates Legion, most players (including all evil players) become evil Legion.
Only 1 jinxed character can be in play.

fanggu.reason: If the Fang Gu chooses an Outsider and dies, the Scarlet Woman does not become the Fang Gu.

spy.reason: When the Spy sees the Grimoire, the Demon and Magician's character tokens are removed.
The Alchemist can not have the Spy ability.
If the Poppy Grower is in play, the Spy does not see the Grimoire until the Poppy Grower dies.
Only 1 jinxed character can be in play.
Only 1 jinxed character can be in play.

widow.reason: When the Widow sees the Grimoire, the Demon and Magician's character tokens are removed.
If the Poppy Grower is in play, the Widow does not see the Grimoire until the Poppy Grower dies.
The Alchemist can not have the Widow ability.
Only 1 jinxed character can be in play.
Only 1 jinxed character can be in play.

godfather.reason: Only 1 jinxed character can be in play.

baron.reason: The Baron might only add 1 Outsider, not 2.

marionette.reason: The Marionette neighbors a Minion, not the Demon. The Marionette is not woken to choose who takes the Lil' Monsta token.
When the Poppy Grower dies, the Demon learns the Marionette but the Marionette learns nothing.
The Marionette does not learn 3 not in-play characters. The Demon learns an extra 3 instead.
If the Marionette thinks that they are the Balloonist, +1 Outsider was added.
The Marionette does not learn that a Damsel is in play.
If the Marionette thinks that they are the Huntsman, the Damsel was added.

riot.reason:
Riot and the Engineer can not both be in play at the start of the game. 
If the Engineer creates Riot, the evil players become Riot.
If The Golem nominates Riot, the Riot player does not die.
If the Snitch is in play, each Riot player gets an extra 3 bluffs.
If a good player nominates and kills the Saint, the Saint's team loses.
The Butler can not nominate their master.

If the Pit-Hag creates Riot, all evil players become Riot. 
If the Pit-Hag creates Riot after day 3, the game continues for one more day.
If the 3rd day begins with just three players alive, the players may choose (as a group) not to nominate at all. If so (and a Mayor is alive) then the Mayor's team wins.
If a Riot player nominates and kills the Monk-protected-player, the Monk-protected-player does not die.
If a Riot player nominates and kills a Farmer, the Farmer uses their ability tonight.
If a Riot player nominates an Innkeeper-protected-player, the Innkeeper-protected-player does not die.
If a Riot player nominates and kills a Sage, the Sage uses their ability tonight.
If a Riot player nominates and kills the Ravenkeeper, the Ravenkeeper uses their ability tonight.
If a Riot player nominates the Soldier, the Soldier does not die.
If a Riot player nominates and kills the Grandchild, the Grandmother dies too.
If a Riot player nominates and kills the King and the Choirboy is alive, the Choirboy uses their ability tonight.
Only 1 jinxed character can be in play.
Only 1 jinxed character can be in play.
Only 1 jinxed character can be in play.
Players that die by nomination register as being executed to the Undertaker.
Players that die by nomination register as being executed to the Cannibal.
Players that die by nomination register as being executed to the Pacifist.
Players that die by nomination register as being executed to the Devil's Advocate.
Riot registers as a Minion to the Investigator.
Riot registers as a Minion to the Clockmaker.
Riot registers as a Minion to the Town Crier.
Riot registers as a Minion to the Damsel.
Riot registers as a Minion to the Preacher.

lleech.reason: If the Mastermind is alive and the Lleech's host dies by execution, the Lleech lives but loses their ability.
If the Slayer slays the Lleech's host, the host dies.
If the Lleech has poisoned the Heretic then the Lleech dies, the Heretic remains poisoned.
